decisions.reason: Requiring molecular property prediction makes the all-mode query too narrow for the broader topic of GNNs in drug discovery.
The phrases form an unambiguous, topically valid intersection of CRISPR, extracellular vesicles, and gene editing.
Requiring climate modeling excludes substantial climate-change applications such as impacts, adaptation, and mitigation.
Requiring both risk assessment and vulnerability is too restrictive for the broad topic of climate-change risks.
Requiring personalized medicine excludes many valid healthcare digital-twin applications.
The phrases clearly target plant responses to the combined heat and drought stresses without an obvious homonym.
Requiring CRISPR excludes non-CRISPR gene-editing approaches relevant to ALS.
Requiring marine pollution and environmental contamination excludes major non-marine and health-related microplastics research.
